summary: Iteration 72 — Full backend + frontend test of new /admin/pdf-test dashboard and admin PDF generation endpoints, plus regression on core routes. All 15 pytest cases pass, and every frontend assertion (title, testids, form defaults, URL construction, internal note) passes. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/pdf_test_admin.py is intentionally unauthenticated per request; before public exposure add is_admin gate.
AdminPdfTest.js uses inline styles heavily (~330 lines) — acceptable for admin utility page but consider extracting shared card style if reused.
seed_data_creation: None — endpoint generates fixture data on the fly
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF admin test dashboard at /admin/pdf-test works end-to-end. Endpoint GET /api/admin/pdf-test/{product} returns 200 + application/pdf for all 6 products (astrocartographie, kabbale, karma-destin, numerologie, theme-natal, synastrie), 404 for unknown, and supports partner_name for synastrie. Regression on /credits, /choix, /astrocartographie, /livres, /admin/analytics, /services/tarot, /outils/tarot all OK.
